title: CUTS vs BULK
directVerdict: CUTS is the thermogenic/cutting pre-workout; BULK is the strength-and-size pre-workout.
majorFormulaDifferences: Only CUTS discloses: Vitamin C: 50 mg per full serving; Chromium: 144 mcg per full serving; Sodium: 20 mg per full serving; L-Carnitine Tartrate: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; Acetyl L-Carnitine HCl: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; Choline Bitartrate: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; Raspberry Ketone: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; Evodiamine: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed.

Only BULK discloses: Creatine Monohydrate: inside Testosterone/Strength Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; D-Aspartic Acid: inside Testosterone/Strength Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; Betaine Anhydrous: inside Testosterone/Strength Matrix; individual amount not disclosed.
CUTS caffeine: CUTS officially lists 300 mg total caffeine per 1 scoop (8 g). BULK caffeine: BULK officially lists 300 mg total caffeine per 1 scoop (11 g).
experience: Both disclose 300 mg caffeine, but their proprietary matrices point in different directions. CUTS centers L-carnitine forms, agmatine, caffeine, bitter orange, and other thermogenic-positioned ingredients. BULK centers creatine, D-Aspartic Acid, betaine, beta-alanine, agmatine, stimulant energy, and strength/testosterone-support positioning.
chooseFirstWhen: Customers seeking a 300 mg caffeine pre-workout
chooseSecondWhen: Customers seeking creatine and 300 mg caffeine
tradeoffs: CUTS: A stimulant-free request; Buyers who require every active ingredient to have an individually disclosed dosage
BULK: A stimulant-free request; Buyers requiring all exact ingredient dosages
bottomLine: Use CUTS for the shopper whose primary goal is a thermogenic pre-workout. Use BULK for the shopper who wants strength, size, creatine, and power positioning. Neither label discloses every individual blend amount.
